outcome: Make npm test run on Node 22 and 24 in CI
criteria: package.json test script names the test files with a pattern that Node 22, 24, and 26 all accept, and the Test workflow is green on all three
head: f1748d5206495c691a0926ec9a36dbe64a75e45e

note: Switched the test script from node --test test/ to node --test test/*.test.js, the pattern DriftSeal uses: sh expands it on Linux and macOS, and Node's own glob handles it where a shell does not. Node 22 and 24 resolved the bare directory as a module and failed with Cannot find module; Node 26 accepted it. Local run green; the CI result on all three versions is checked after push, so the second half of the criterion is attested from the workflow run, not from here.
head: f1748d5206495c691a0926ec9a36dbe64a75e45e
